applicabilityBasis.summary: USDT is a fiat-referenced dollar token designed for payments and settlement, with issuer redemption for eligible verified customers at fixed fiat value less applicable fees.

genius.notes: Tether's January 27, 2026 USAT launch release says USD₮ is progressing towards GENIUS Act compliance, while USA₮ is issued by Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. for the U.S. domestic market; this is issuer-announced intent, not USDT authorization. The issuer remains Tether International, S.A. de C.V. in El Salvador under CNAD. In the public OCC/Treasury sources searched on 2026-10-01, no USDT foreign-issuer approval or Treasury comparability determination for Tether/El Salvador was established; this negative public review does not establish that no confidential or unpublished application was filed. The March 2 OCC framework and August 17 Treasury section 3 framework are proposed rules, not evidence of an issuer-specific authorization. foreignExceptionStatus and issuerPathway remain unknown. Current reserve evidence is quarterly BDO ISAE3000R assurance; the separately announced August 13 KPMG audit covers FY2025 financial statements and is not a monthly attestation. The CFTC October 2021 reserve-misrepresentation order and NYAG February 2021 settlement are preserved as historical non-GENIUS enforcement evidence, not an issuer-specific GENIUS section 3 order.
